أتذابح (form VI)
# أَتَذَابَحُ (ʔataḏābaḥu) /ʔa.ta.ðaː.ba.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
# أَتَذَابَحَ (ʔataḏābaḥa) /ʔa.ta.ðaː.ba.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
# أَتَذَابَحْ (ʔataḏābaḥ) /ʔa.ta.ðaː.baħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَذَابَحَ (taḏābaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
